title: Toyota is recalling over 300,000 vehicles. See affected models - USA Today

 Amaris Encinas USA TODAY Nov. 19, 2026, 2:02 p.m. ET Hear this story More than 300,000 Toyota vehicles are being recalled over a potential defect with the driver air bag that may increase the risk of serious injury or death.
 According to a safety notice posted by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing found that seven different vehicle models were equipped with certain Takata front passenger air bag inflators either as original equipment, or as a replacement part under a prior recall.
 Continued, prolonged exposure to extreme humidity, high temperatures or a combination of both may cause the inflator to rupture due to "propellant degradation." An inflator rupture could cause metal fragments to pass through the airbag and into the vehicle at high-speed.
 Among the affected vehicles included in the recall were several Toyota and Lexus brand vehicles produced between 2002 and 2017, though not all of the involved vehicles were sold in the U.S.
 As of Nov. 6, no Toyota Field Technical Reports or warranty claims stemming from the condition have been reported in the U.S.
 Here's what to know about Toyota's recall, including all of the vehicle models that were impacted.
 USDA health alert: Do not eat these recalled breakfast items Which Toyota models were affected by this recall?
 The models affected by the recall include:
 Lexus GX (2017)
 Lexus IS (2011)
 Lexus SC (2002-2010)
 Toyota 4Runner (2016-2017)
 Toyota Corolla (2003-2008)
 Toyota Sequoia (2005-2007)
 Toyota Tundra (2005-2006)
 According to the report, the total number of Toyota brand vehicles "potentially involved" stands at 314,029.

How the tech will work What affected vehicle owners should do
 "All known owners" of the affected Toyota and Lexus brand vehicle models will be instructed to take their vehicle to its respective dealer, where the either the front passenger air bag inflator or air bag assembly will be replaced, free of charge.
 Affected vehicle owners will be notified beginning Monday, Dec. 28. Owners may reach out to Toyota's customer service by calling (800)-331-4431, or NHTSA's Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171).
 Toyota's number(s) for the recall are: 26TB25, 26TA25, 26LB11, and 26LA11.
